# xby-json-rpc
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的插件：JSON-RPC服务
一个基于OpenRPC的Model Context Protocol (MCP)服务器，提供JSON-RPC功能调用和方法发现服务。
## 功能

- **set_xby_apikey** — 在聊天中设置 API 密钥（自动持久化，重启有效）
- **rpc_call** — Call any JSON-RPC method on a serv

er with parameters. A user would prompt: Call method <method> on <server url> with params <params>
-
**rpc_discover** — This uses JSON-RPC to call `rpc.discover` which is part of the OpenRPC Specifica
tion for discovery for JSON-RPC servers. A user would prompt: What JSON-RPC methods does this server
for JSON-RPC servers. A user would prompt: What JSON-RPC methods does this server have? <server url>
